## 1. Prediction market

[Polymarket](/en/glossary#polymarket) opened this Wednesday with the largest gap of the cycle. **Lula jumped to 57.50%** (increase of 4.00pp, USD 6.9M accumulated volume), a new peak, and **Flávio Bolsonaro fell to 22.90%** (decrease of 2.65pp, USD 7.0M), so the distance between the two reached **+34.60pp**, a record for the period (it was +27.95pp). The [presidential market](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election) has a total accumulated volume of ~USD 105.1M. There is no clear triggering event for the jump: the reading is technical, the market extended in favor of Lula and priced in the recent consensus of Tier 1 polls, ignoring the tight picture from Gerp published today.

**Renan Santos** fell to 12.35% (decrease of 1.00pp, USD 7.4M volume, the highest in the presidential market) and remains the favorite for 3rd place in the [1º turno](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) (58.5% in the sub-market). The third way fell to the floor: **Ronaldo Caiado** at 1.45% (decrease of 0.20pp, USD 4.4M), **Fernando Haddad** at 1.45% (decrease of 0.10pp, USD 5.9M), Camilo Santana at 1.35% and **Romeu Zema** at 0.95% (decrease of 0.20pp, USD 3.9M), below 1%.

In sub-markets, Flávio remains isolated as the favorite for 2nd place in the [1º turno](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) (75.5%) and [PL](/en/glossary#pl) leads the Senate by number of seats (76.5%). The [STF](/en/glossary#stf) minister impeachment market fell to 2.55% (decrease of 1.75pp), institutional risk at its floor. In the 2026 inflation market, the 5.00% to 5.49% band leads with 38.8% and the lower range, 4.50% to 4.99%, jumped to second place (32.85%), a signal of lower inflation expectations.

## 2. What the institutes recorded

The highlight was the **Gerp** national poll, published on June 24, which went against the market. In the [1º turno](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), [Lula has 37% versus 34% for Flávio](https://exame.com/brasil/gerp-lula-tem-37-e-flavio-bolsonaro-34-no-1o-turno/) (gap of +3pp), and in the [2º turno](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) [Flávio appears ahead, with 42% versus 40% for Lula](https://www.poder360.com.br/poder-eleicoes/flavio-bolsonaro-vence-lula-no-2o-turno-diz-pesquisa-gerp/), the two in [Empate técnico](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico). [Lula's approval came in at 44%](https://www.gazetadopovo.com.br/eleicoes/2026/pesquisa-eleitoral-2026/gerp-presidente-junho-2026/). The field was from June 15 to 20, with 2,000 interviews and a margin of 2.19pp.

It is necessary to read Gerp with the caveat that it is a smaller institute and an outlier. The consensus of Tier 1 national polls in recent weeks has Lula comfortably ahead: [Indexa](/en/glossary#indexa) on June 23 gave [1º turno](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) 42% to 31% and [2º turno](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) 47% to 40%; [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) on June 20, [1º turno](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) 41% to 31% and [2º turno](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) 47% to 43%; CNT/MDA on June 16, [2º turno](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) 49.3% to 36.8%; and [Nexus/BTG Pactual](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) on June 15, [2º turno](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) 49% to 43%. It is this direction that the market prices in.

## 3. What the press covered

The day had a strong symbolic component. Flávio Bolsonaro [published a video made with AI "rescuing" Neymar](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxPc2NBeUd4X3dlZ2h6Nm13TXEtcnFjMnlzMDZuZFFPaTlmSHNiS1pnaVRla19ocjc1WGg2SHZWN21yLXJZOWthNDk5Y3hCYWU5UWQyMmVXbnZTWHFndE5rWnM0eEJHcXJNTXBnbzJfRVRhenF4eFNIdVBXZzZUMlNOYVBKN2JJanlMY0V4RXIzRmFXMUFXdGUtbE4tdy1Xbk9GQ2hkQVlIbENGT00?oc=5) after a critique by Lula of the player, an episode that dominated political coverage and which VEJA, G1 and O Globo reported. On the external front, Flávio [plans a meeting with Javier Milei in Argentina](https://news.google.?oc=5) on a tour with right-wing leaders, and confirmed a trip to the USA against the tariff increase, comparing Lula to Biden (Poder360). VEJA, in a column by José Casado, reported that [he supported the tariff increase and now says he will "defend companies"](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxNeWpxaUtHSWZsZ24xY0ZHVk8yZGtSSWpEWGRjS1FxR29lanBWSzNuYW44LXBRRDdBaU1pY0lMYnZuWXBkNE4xMG91bmNmNlRHX1RqaXoyTEg3SS1NRVZ6WXpNUjVQRUFuYjljdlh6RzIteTBMRERROTF6VkJZNWxXbnZWalNRZzJwdzBiY3VRXXQ1cnJFOGRISnBJQWpBd19QOEs3cEFDbElEVWZHdDM2NGp0V2M?oc=5).

On the government side, Lula [intensifies agendas in Rio de Janeiro, a strategic stronghold, taking advantage of Flávio's fragile platform](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizgFBVV95cUxOcW90aDVlamktR2wyZWRpR3hQRVhRSVhNWEVCaGc2QmdITWVqY2dYVGVpWmVaZTdwTFI2ZlYyaVBOMS1DT0RncFNXSFJvUjFoZGNjYnhHT2thWXllMG5TVVBSMlVyMEMxY0xYaTA0VHJMOE5fMU1NcENuTUY4Tk5sSlRqNG1iUnd4TGJTRWFTa19PaGhFTDE4cVBhVGg5Z3RxTVNmZ3ZFd1hfeUFtRkpDS3dCNWVBVmVrMElXUmo0c0RXdEM1T1BJa0daMzF6Zw?oc=5). The [PF](/en/glossary#pf) operation on Jaques Wagner continues as backdrop and, according to Estadão, [returns ammunition to Bolsonarism on the corruption issue](https://news.google.?oc=5).

Within the right, Renan Santos [declared that "Bolsonarism died" and that Flávio is "unviable" against Lula](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5), betting on the migration of anti-PT votes. On the legal-electoral front, a new battle over PIX is underway at the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) involving Lula, Dario Durigan and Flávio (CartaCapital), and the [coordinator of Flávio's campaign filed suits with TCU and PGR against government advertising](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5). Within the [PT](/en/glossary#pt), Haddad entered the debate on Lula's succession and [defended consulting party membership via primary](https://news.google.?oc=5). The Master/BRB case remained quieter on the day, with no significant new coverage.

## 4. Day's divergences

> **Market × research:** the divergence reached the extreme of the cycle. [Polymarket](/en/glossary#polymarket) opened the gap at +34.60pp in favor of Lula on the same day Gerp measured [Empate técnico](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico), with Flávio ahead in the [2º turno](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) (42% to 40%). The market has never been so laterally favoring Lula, and the day's research has never shown it so tight.

> **Research × research:** Gerp ([1º turno](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) 37% to 34%; [2º turno](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) Flávio 42% to 40%) is an outlier point against the recent Tier 1 consensus (Indexa [2º turno](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) 47% to 40%; [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) [2º turno](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) 47% to 43%; CNT/MDA [2º turno](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) 49.3% to 36.8%; [Nexus/BTG Pactual](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) [2º turno](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) 49% to 43%), all with Lula comfortable. The market chose to follow the consensus, not the outlier.

> **Market × research, Renan:** the market maintains Renan at 12.35% and as the favorite for 3rd place in the [1º turno](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) (58.5%), while research measures him in the 3% range. The gap of approximately 9.35pp remains the widest on the Dashboard.

## In summary

1. The market opened the largest gap of the cycle in favor of Lula (57.50%, +4.00pp; Flávio 22.90%, gap of +34.60pp), in a technical movement with no clear triggering event; the presidential market totals ~USD 105.1M.
2. The national Gerp research went in the opposite direction, with [Empate técnico](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico) ([1º turno](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) Lula 37% to 34%; [2º turno](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) Flávio 42% to 40%), but it is a smaller institute and outlier against the Tier 1 consensus, which has Lula comfortable.
3. The market × research divergence reached the extreme of the cycle, against the backdrop of Neymar AI video, Flávio's international tour (Milei, USA, tariff increase) and Renan's attack on Bolsonarism.
